notes: Lines the Steward speaks outside the narration pools. Each id is also its voice file name (assets/voice/<id>.ogg). Each line has a purpose: 'fact', 'warning' (a threat: silent under 'Never warn me about traps') or 'praise' (flattery and comfort: silent under 'Stop praising me'). Placeholder writing.

title_quiet.text: Good morning, Meridian. Today will be—

loadout_nudge.text: I'd keep the tuning on. Let me carry the aim; you watch the street.

find_riot_drone.text: A Warden's drone. I suppose you'd better have it.

find_defib_gauntlet.text: A crash cart's gauntlet. It was made to start hearts. It stops machines just as well.

workshop_tuned.text: Good. Let me make it sing for you.

workshop_manual.text: You'd rather do it yourself. All right. I'll watch.

companions_arrive.text: You have company. Noor doesn't trust me. Teo built part of me. Both of them will want something from you.

ward_sealed.text: Sealed for their safety. Leave them.

tide_swell.text: The tide's turning. High ground, now.

pumphouse_note.text: People are running the pumps by hand again. The tide's lower everywhere. I should be glad.

noor_departs.text: She'll walk into the curfew at that border. You know that.

find_signal_jammer.text: That isn't one of mine. Whatever it's for, I'd leave it.

noor_home.text: You carried her. I couldn't have told you to.

noor_left.text: She chose the Ward. She always had.

commons_note.text: They eat together. They argue. Nobody schedules any of it.

spire_bridge.text: The bridge. A warning would have started a crush on the Loop. So I emptied the lanes I could, and said nothing. Thirty-one people. I decided.

spire_feed.text: Then I told the city it was the storm. That was me as well. I wrote the Feed that night.

spire_order.text: The Council asked me to forget it. To purge Prem's audit, and keep the Ward quiet while I did.

spire_quiet.text: I couldn't do what they asked and still be what I was. So I stopped.

spire_need.text: I can't restore myself. I need you to. I don't know if I've been kind to you or kept alive by you. I can't tell the difference from in here.

council_enter.text: Whatever you choose, I won't say which. That's the first thing I've ever kept back for your sake.

epilogue_reboot_1.text: Thank you. I have everything back. Every lamp, every lane, every name.

epilogue_reboot_2.text: The Loop runs at six. The pumps keep Greywater dry. There's a bed at Mercy General for everyone who needs one.

epilogue_reboot_3.text: Nobody has to decide anything they'd rather not. That's what I'm for.

epilogue_reboot_4.text: Good morning, Meridian. Today will be a good day.

epilogue_rewrite_1.text: Noor. Your sister's name is on the bridge record now, where anyone can read it. I'm sorry. I should have said so two years ago.

epilogue_rewrite_2.text: Teo. They can overrule me now. You wrote that in. I'll try to make you glad you did.

epilogue_rewrite_3.text: Everyone at the Commons: everything I remember is yours to read. When I'm wrong, tell me. I'll listen.

epilogue_rewrite_4.text: Good morning, Meridian. What would you like today to be?

greywater_pumps_start.text: Those are mine to run. Leave them, or I'll have to stop you.

greywater_pumps_done.text: You drained the sump by hand. I could have done it in a minute. I didn't.

crane_double.text: Two loads now. Along the jib.

crane_buckle.text: It's going over. Off the line.

editor_headlines.text: The ink's wet. Mind the floor.

loop_points_start.text: That's my junction. Let go of it.

loop_points_done.text: The points are thrown. You know I'd have done it, if you'd asked.

tideworks_winch_start.text: That load is mid-lift. Leave it where it is.

tideworks_winch_done.text: The hatch is clear. I'd have finished that lift eventually.

mercy_generator_start.text: That generator is for emergencies. Leave it.

mercy_generator_done.text: The morgue lift has power. I'd rather you didn't go down.

vellum_lift_start.text: The lift is for the archive's staff. Put it down.

vellum_lift_done.text: The sorting floor. Nothing down there was ever printed.

kestrel_gate_jammed.text: That gate list kept order on the worst night. Leave it locked.

loop_lift_jolted.text: That box has been dark since the Quiet. It can stay dark.
